summary: Iteration 3 — multi-Claude-model selection surface fully verified. 12/12 targeted backend tests passed in 99.57s against public URL (serial -n 0). GET /api/models returns default=claude-sonnet-4-6 with all 4 model IDs (sonnet-5, sonnet-4-6, haiku-4-5-20251001, opus-4-7) each carrying id/label/tier/desc; public (bogus auth header still 200). PATCH /api/auth/preferences: 401 without token, 400 for gpt-4, 200 for haiku-4-5-20251001 with /api/auth/me reflecting the change. POST /api/analyze verified in three model resolutions on real 25KB PCB JPEG fixture — explicit haiku (model_used=haiku), omitted-with-preferred (model_used=haiku via user pref), invalid 'foo' soft-falls-back (model_used=haiku, NOT 'foo'). POST /api/chat with model=claude-opus-4-7 streams SSE deltas + done and persists both user+assistant history. Regression: new user with no preferred_model + no analyze payload model → project.model_used == claude-sonnet-4-6 (default). Cleanup: seeded user test@insideout.app preferred_model reset to claude-sonnet-4-6 and all 3 iteration projects deleted, per instructions.
